title: TMC: Too Many Crafts!
description: Adds recipes for items that have no in-game recipes!
body:
This is a personal datapack for adding recipes for items that otherwise don't have recipes, as an "all-in-one" bundle instead of individual items.

I tried to balance them according to their use and when players would be expected to obtain them, but I'm open to suggestions for improving.

Adds recipes for the following items:
- Bells
- Chainmail armor
- Echo Shards
- Elytras
- Flow, Guster, and Snout banner patterns
- Gilded Blackstone
- Hearts of the Sea
- Heavy Cores
- (Non-leather) Horse armor
- Nautilus armor
- Enchanted Golden Apples
- Saddles
- Totems of Undying
- Tridents

It also includes the following QoL changes:
- Raw ore blocks can be smelted in the Blast Furnace
- Rotten flesh can be turned into leather using the Smoker or a Campfire
- Nether wart blocks can be uncrafted back into nine individual items, meaning they can actually be used for storage!
